## New Features

**Agent: E2B Sandbox, Home Snapshots, and Skill Management**
- **E2B sandbox backend**: agent shell/code execution can now run on [E2B](https://e2b.dev) cloud sandboxes in addition to the local sandbox. * New desktop onboarding flow on first launch
* Caches resolved model metadata between requests, cutting time-to-first-token by roughly half (TTFT dropped from ~995 ms to ~524 ms in benchmarks)
